title: Scottsdale 6BR | Pool, Spa & Putting Green
description:
Welcome to the Desert Dreams Getaway! Gather your group at this spacious six-bedroom retreat near Kierland Commons and Scottsdale Quarter. Featuring two private primary suites, two living areas, a chef’s kitchen and room for up to 18 guests, the home is ideal for families traveling together. Outside, enjoy a private heated pool, hot tub, putting green, grill and plenty of space to relax—just minutes from TPC Scottsdale, WestWorld, shopping, dining and golf.

 The space 
Welcome to Desert Dreams Getaway, a spacious six-bedroom retreat conveniently located near Kierland Commons, Scottsdale Quarter, TPC Scottsdale and WestWorld.

Designed for families and groups traveling together, the home features two private primary suites—one upstairs and one downstairs—along with two living areas and a large, fully equipped kitchen. With room to spread out, guests can enjoy time together without feeling crowded.

Outdoor retreat
• Private pool with optional heating
• Private hot tub
• Backyard putting green
• Gas grill
• Outdoor dining and lounge seating
• Private fenced backyard

Inside the home
• Six bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms
• Two king primary suites with private bathrooms
• Two separate living areas
• Spacious, fully equipped kitchen
• Smart TVs and Wi-Fi
• Washer and dryer
• Starter supply of toiletries, paper products and laundry detergent

Sleeping arrangements
• Bedroom 1: King bed and ensuite bathroom—downstairs
• Bedroom 2: King bed and ensuite bathroom—upstairs
• Bedroom 3: Queen bed
• Bedroom 4: Two twin-over-full bunk beds
• Bedroom 5: Queen bed
• Bedroom 6: Queen bed

Nearby destinations
• Westin Kierland Golf Club: approximately 1.2 miles
• Kierland Commons: approximately 1.5 miles
• Scottsdale Quarter: approximately 1.5 miles
• TPC Scottsdale: approximately 3 miles
• Fairmont Scottsdale Princess: approximately 2.5 miles
• WestWorld of Scottsdale: approximately 4.5 miles
• Old Town Scottsdale: approximately 10 miles
• Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport: approximately 19 miles

Whether you’re visiting for golf, spring training, Barrett-Jackson, shopping or a family getaway, this home offers plenty of space and an excellent North Scottsdale-area location.

Pool heating is available for an additional $75 per night. Early check-in and late checkout may be available for an additional fee. *Please note – per the city of Scottsdale’s policies, rental properties cannot occupy more than 6 adults and their dependent children at a time and this property cannot be used for any events.

TPT License #21160724

 Guest access 
The guest can access the entire home, the front and back yard, and the pool.

 Other things to note 
There is a heated pool available to use during your stay for an additional $75/night.

Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged for an additional fee pending availability.

We have 5 other homes in the Scottsdale area with fun decor and great for large families or groups. Click our profile for links to see the rest of our listings.
